opening.argument: The narration walks viewers through ordinary Coinbase tasks: setting up an account, navigating the app, buying and selling cryptocurrency, converting assets, and withdrawing funds. The order preview displays a Coinbase fee, and the payment-method screen fits that account-use tutorial rather than showing a request to transfer funds to an unrelated recipient. An in-app offer of free Bitcoin also appears, but its full terms and outcome are not shown. On this evidence, the offer is contextual product content, not sufficient evidence of a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: We'll show you how to set up your account, navigate the app, invest and withdraw money.
